name: Weavers Way Farm Market
description: Weavers Way Farm Market offers local organic seasonal produce as well as local dairy, freshly baked bread, local ice cream, pasture-raised eggs and meats, raw honey, flowers, and more! Produce grown at Weavers Way Farms is sold at The Farm Market. The Farm Market is located at Saul Agricultural High School. The farm and market operate in collaboration with the high school and provide educational opportunities for Saul students, who manage the farm along with their teachers and Weavers Way staff. Like the Co-op stores, the market is open to the public — you don’t need to be a member of the Co-op to shop. Weavers Way Co-op member benefits also apply at the market, including working member discounts, Food for All (low-income) discounts, and senior discounts. As payment, we accept cash, credit/debit/EBT cards, EasyPay (for Co-op members), Farmers Market Nutrition vouchers (FMNP), Philly Food Bucks and Food Bucks Rx. Visit our website for hours at weaversway.coop.
directions: Parking options: Upon entering the parking next to the Farm Market (watch for Farm Market signs), you can park at the first parking lot to the right, or in the grass in front of the pasture to the left of the livestock barn.
